description: Earnings pre-announcements and flash reports for one A-share. `forecasts` = mandatory guided ranges (net-profit floor/ceiling CNY + YoY); `express` = voluntary unaudited actuals. `direction` (positive / negative / uncertain) comes from the forecast TYPE, not the percentage (turnaround names have misleading YoY). Every revision is kept with `revision` (first / revised_up / revised_down / revised_flat); `has_downward_revision` flags a downgrade. ⚠️ Flash reports are voluntary and sparse — an absent `express` is normal.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

periods.description: How many recent report periods to return (1-12, default 4)

name: earnings_show
